name: Lolotte
message: 「What am I apologizing for... you ask?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ahem! According to my guidebook, today is 'Apology Day'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So I am apologizing to everyone I meet, one after another」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Formally, it seems you're supposed to do it barefoot on a snowy day, but it's cold so I refuse」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. Nobody wants to go barefoot on a cold day, do they. I understand」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's true, you know. In the guidebook...」
